{{Top}}
[[File:MotionSensor-HtH2.png|thumb|right|200px|An underwater motions sensor on Rodia]]

A '''motion sensor''', also called a '''motion detector''', '''motion trigger''', or '''sensor trip''', was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that could detect movement.

==History==
[[File:Christophsis_motion_sensors.png|thumb|left|200px|Motion sensors on Christophsis]]

During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], pressure-sensitive motions sensors were used to guard the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom's]] advancing [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]]. When triggered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the sensors activated concealed [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|LR-57 combat droids]] which broke through the ground and attacked the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] used motion sensors under the [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] swamp to protect an abandoned [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] station he was using as a hideout. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and his [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]] approached the station under the surface of the water, the ripples caused by their swimming movements tripped the sensors which activated [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that Robonino had reprogrammed and triggered powerful blaster cannons located on each side of the sensor.

[[Kuat City]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] [[Tekshar Falls Casino]] had buildup motion sensor to trigger [[Force field/Legends|force field]] to part [[Tekshar Falls]] prior visitor was able to enter their establishment.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were fitted with motion sensors.<ref name="TRG1-112">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
